messages:
emily-l: Heads up — new in-the-wild exploit for zstd decompressor library, CVE-2026-2819. PoC shows OOB read leading to remote code execution when decompressing untrusted streams. Affects our inference image that pulls models from S3 and a handful of sidecar tools.

raj-patel: link to advisory?

emily-l: https://security-advisories.example.org/CVE-2026-2819 — vendor patched in zstd 1.5.4.1 and 1.4.11.2.

mike-g: confirmed one of our internal images pins zstd 1.4.10 in runtime-builder. Impact looks real for any service that does automatic decompress of uploaded artifacts.

security-oncall: can we disable automatic decompression at ingress temporarily?

anya: yes — file-upload proxy has flag --auto-decompress=true. I can flip to false in staging now.

infra-bot: canary rollout triggered: staging -> 2 pods, region-us-west-2. Command: kubectl set env deploy/file-proxy AUTO_DECOMPRESS=false -n infra && kubectl rollout status deploy/file-proxy -n infra :eyes:

raj-patel: detection playbook coming. Search for unusually large decompression memory spikes and failed inflate errors around decompress_stream() in logs. Query: 
```
severity:warning AND (msg:decompress OR msg:inflate) AND (error:*oob* OR error:*out of bounds* )
```

emily-l: urgent patch plan: 1) bump zstd in builder and runtime images to patched minor, 2) rebuild images, 3) canary-deploy in us-west, 4) full rollout with maxUnavailable=1.

mike-g: I'm on the build + test. ETA 45m for image build and container scan.

security-oncall: also add short-term mitigations: - disable auto-decompress - block uploads > 200MB to model-artifacts bucket - add WAF rule to block suspicious multipart requests.

anya: adding S3 bucket notification rule to send samples of newly uploaded archives to quarantine bucket for offline analysis. Patch will need IAM tweak: S3:PutObject for quarantine svc-account.

emily-l: audit logging ask: enable debug-level decompression logs for two hours in canary to capture any exploit attempts, and ship to long-term audit (30d). We need request IDs for any suspicious decompress operations.

raj-patel: KMS question: do we need to rotate keys? The exploit looks code-exec on decompress path, not key leakage, so not required now. But lock down key access for build accounts until we finish root-cause.

mike-g: built and pushed runtime: redwood/runtime:2026-06-18-zstd-1.5.4.1-cve2819. Scans clean. Pushing canary now.

infra-bot: canary deployed to us-west-2 (2 pods). Health: green.

security-oncall: start incident doc and comms draft. Add impacted surfaces: hosted-api model upload, dedicated import service, on-prem installers that bundle zstd.

emily-l: comms: customer-facing note should say patched runtime and recommended immediate action for dedicated/private customers: upgrade to patched image or apply vendor patch for zstd. Draft in #announcements after approvals.

anya: added detection rule in SIEM and created an alert channel #sec-alerts if pattern matches. Also created an internal ticket INFRA-4282 for IAM change.

raj-patel: quick IOC check: run grep across artifacts bucket for files with .zst and verify checksums/age. Script: 
```
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-model-artifacts/ --recursive | grep .zst
```

mike-g: rolling to prod with maxUnavailable=1 — starting now. Will monitor latency and OOM rates.

infra-bot: prod rollout started. 5/120 pods unavailable during rolling update (within target).

security-oncall: detection alert fired in staging — one decompress error with "out of bounds read" from ip 54.82.11.23 at 15:12 UTC. Captured sample in quarantine.

emily-l: good catch. Analyst to triage sample and forward to malware team. Also leave webhooks on to capture any further attempts.

anya: quarantine sample fetched, static analysis shows malformed header consistent with PoC. Dropping to malware team now.

raj-patel: postmortem checklist: - timeline - detection rules effectiveness - why auto-decompress enabled by default - add explicit opt-in for auto-decompress on private deployments - update onboarding docs.

security-oncall: assigned owners: emily-l (incident lead), mike-g (patch + rollout), anya (detection + quarantine), raj-patel (postmortem).

emily-l: final note: after full rollout we'll schedule emergency KB and a follow-up RFC to tighten artifact handling. Thanks all — keep monitoring for 24h. :thumbsup:
